coordinateConvention: Original PNG pixels: x right, y down. Stroke center estimates, not physical units. Uncertainty is about 4 pixels for trace landmarks and about 2 pixels for clear lattice tracks.

sourceOnlyImageOpens.meaning: Original fig25 pixels enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor, not a candidate.

groups.facts: One shared frame. Horizontal time axis extends left of origin and ends in a right arrow. Vertical sweep-voltage axis extends below origin and ends in an up arrow. Origin approximately [56,175]; right arrow tip [513,181]; up arrow tip [55,17]; left axis end [20,174]; bottom reaches about [54,279]. No grid or ticks.

Single continuous solid sawtooth: three rising runs, two complete steep downward resets, three baseline crossings, and a final partial rising run. It begins at the low left vertex, not at the origin. No arrows on the trace, no extra cycle, no numeric values.
groups.readFromGraphValues: None requested by lesson; no marked physical values to reconstruct.

modernRegularizationAllowed: Make axes orthogonal and baseline level rather than preserving scan slant.
Make the two rapid resets vertical, avoiding scan-induced backward time.
Use equal slopes/heights for the repeated sawtooth runs while retaining two full runs and the partial third.
Use renderer-owned English mathematical labels u-subscript-p, O, t; omit scan noise.

groups.facts: Complete upright dark almost-rectangular housing, broad dark lower band, light mounting plate with rounded/beveled corners, circular CRT screen with double concentric rim. Screen center about [216,220], inner radius about 165-166 pixels; rim extends roughly x45..387, y50..391. All four dark fasteners visible at plate corners. No invented knobs, ports, status lights, modern rectangular display, or cropped-off lower band.
groups.contamination: Known isolated caption-tip pixel on last row is not instructional apparatus and must not become modern content.

groups.facts: Complete circle-bounded lattice, not a rectangular graph. Nineteen vertical tracks and seventeen horizontal tracks, including short edge tracks and the boundary-truncated cells. Rim bands and top curved border fragments are not extra horizontal tracks. Tracks lean slightly left lower down, and the scan shows uneven spacing. No separately drawn/labeled axes. Center lines are ordinary graticule lines.
groups.coreForExecutableGridAssertion: The interior tracks indexed -6..6 in each direction define a genuine full rectangular core, 12 columns by 12 rows. This is a subset of the visible circular lattice, not its total. Remaining whole tracks and every core-track extension must terminate at the circle.

groups.facts: One solid continuous unarrowed curve. Starts on left near the middle, descends to a deep first trough, rises to the largest crest, then alternates through progressively smaller extrema. Four troughs and four crests total. The final small crest and falling tail are visible. The trace ends inside the screen, not at the right rim. It is not a constant-amplitude sinusoid.
groups.crossingsOfApproxReferenceLevel: Seven between successive trough/crest landmarks; the initial downward portion starts just below the reference, and the final falling tail ends near it. No labeled zero axis is present.
groups.readFromGraphValues: No queried calibrated coordinates, periods, decay constants, or exact voltages in either draft.

modernRegularizationAllowed: Circularize the slight scan distortion of the round CRT and straighten housing edges.
Regularize lattice spacing/skew into one shared phase, without deleting any of its 19 vertical or 17 horizontal tracks or boundary extensions.
Draw all four fasteners as clear uncalibrated circles and retain the light mount plus dark lower housing band.
Use deterministic monotone cubic pieces through every independently inventoried trace endpoint/extremum; no fitted sine law or numeric units.
Use semantic muted/grid strokes and accent trace to improve separation, without changing topology.
